notes: The cognate infinitive absolute takes *abundantly* as its own unit under rule 56, the finite verb keeping its subject pronoun, auxiliary and lexical verb; the margin's *Or, surely* was read and set aside under rule 38.

`לֶחֶם` is the hiphil's second accusative, so the supplied *with* is the preposition the English verb needs to reach an object the Hebrew writes bare and belongs to the verb (rule 44), not to the noun under rule 33.
